data.name: The Curse in the Village - Remastered
data.detailed_description:
A Dark Legacy, Reimagined. Originally a mobile horror pioneer in 2015 with over 2 million downloads, this terrifying journey has been completely rebuilt for PC. The Curse in the Village offers a surreal nightmare where the boundaries between reality and the void blur.

Chapters of Horror:

  • Chapter 1: Shattered Reality: It begins with a simple glass of water at night. But when doors slam shut and you find yourself watching three demons performing a ritual over your own sleeping body, you’ll realize this is no ordinary dream.

  • Chapter 2: The Village Cellar: A mysterious TV broadcast leads you to a cellar that transports you to an abandoned village house. Trapped and hunted, you must find three hidden keys within the shadows to unlock your escape.

  • Bonus Chapter: Celestial Terror: Escape is not the end. A colossal demon looms in the sky, reaching for your soul. Collect three ancient amulets and place them in time to banish the ancient curse.

Key Features:

  • Enhanced PC Experience: High-fidelity lighting and immersive spatial audio designed for PC.

  • Surreal Storytelling: Experience a world where environments shift and reality twists without warning.

  • Intense Puzzles: Scavenge for resources, solve intricate puzzles, and survive the jump-scares.

Witness Your Own Nightmare...

"The Curse in the Village" is a first-person psychological horror game where the line between reality and nightmare vanishes. Can you survive this terrifying journey that begins with a man waking up for a glass of water, only to watch himself being sacrificed by demons in his own bed?

Key Features:

  • Reality-Shifting Horror: A surreal transition from a modern city apartment to an uncanny, derelict village house filled with dark secrets of the past.

  • Mind Games: Experience a heavy atmosphere where doors slam in your face, the TV speaks directly to you, and demons lurk in every shadow.

  • Puzzles and Survival: Find hidden levers to escape the depths of the cellar and solve the mysteries within the house to unlock the three ancient seals on the exit.

  • Bonus Chapter (The Great Evil): Collect the sacred amulets and complete the ritual before a colossal demon looming in the sky reaches you.

data.short_description: The 2015 mobile horror classic with 2 million downloads is back, reimagined for PC! Witness your own dark ritual, solve the mysteries of a cursed village, and outrun a colossal celestial demon. Experience a surreal journey where reality shatters and every shadow hides a curse.
